photo.providerPrivacy: After you select a photo, it is sent to the AI provider to check whether it meets the requirements. Full outfit analysis starts only after you press “Start analysis.” The provider may keep it briefly for abuse monitoring; confirm the exact retention period before launch.
photo.localPrivacy: This service does not keep photos or results. They cannot be restored after you leave or refresh.

reason.CLOTHING_UNRECOGNIZABLE: We can’t reliably identify the clothing. Please retake a clear photo of the full outfit.
